findings.what: The new students.ts route file (studentAdminRoutes) is said to register 'under a /students prefix' but the concrete apps/api/src/server.ts edit and the /api/<name> prefix convention are not stated.
findings.fix: State explicitly: add `await app.register(studentAdminRoutes, { prefix: "/api/students" });` to apps/api/src/server.ts; confirm no collision with self-service routes on student.ts (/api/student/me/*).

findings.what: The /me/services active-module resolution is named only by analogy ('the same mechanism requireModuleActive uses'); the exact query and the module-key -> entry-point map shape are unspecified.
findings.fix: Specify the read, e.g. tx.institutionModule.findMany({ where: { institutionId, state: "ACTIVE" } }) inside withTenant, plus the literal module-key -> self-service-entry map. The ACTIVE-only filter / SUSPENDED-ENTITLED-NOT_ENTITLED exclusion is already unambiguous.

findings.what: The folded-in importer switches its audit key from the live admin.students.imported to the new students.student.imported 'going forward', a behavioral change to a live route's audit stream (verified admin.ts currently writes admin.students.imported).
findings.fix: Pick one and state it: (a) keep writing admin.students.imported and drop the new key, or (b) keep the switch but note that any audit filter keyed on the old import key must union both.

findings.what: The rationale for avoiding `migrate dev --create-only` ('may trip the superadmin checksum into a reset prompt') is stronger than database.md supports; database.md records the drift as harmless/deploy-tolerated and lists --create-only as the standard generation step. The chosen hand-author + migrate diff (read-only) + migrate deploy path is itself correct.
findings.fix: Reword to: --create-only is unnecessary because the migration is hand-authored for RLS/trigger/grant/seed SQL regardless; confirm modelled DDL with read-only `migrate diff`, apply with `migrate deploy`. Drop the speculative reset-prompt claim.
